name: Shibotte! Futa Milk
source:
Main character has to hide at the rooftop from classmates one day. When he finally decides to go home, he witnesses female classmate's secret and forcibly takes her as a result. Girl transfers to another school in three days, so she suggests using her body at will during this time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
